name: Market Claim Creation V 04
definition: Scope and Usage|The MarketClaimCreation message is sent by an account servicer to an account holder to advise the creation of a market claim transaction on a securities account, that has been automatically generated (for example by a CSD) on a mandatory distribution type of corporate action event. |This message definition is intended for use with the Business Application Header (BAH).

TransactionReference.name: Transaction Reference
TransactionReference.definition: References of the transaction for which the securities settlement condition modification is requested.

CorporateActionGeneralInformation.name: Corporate Action General Information
CorporateActionGeneralInformation.definition: General information about the corporate action event.

RelatedSettlementInstructionDetails.name: Related Settlement Instruction Details
RelatedSettlementInstructionDetails.definition: Information about the related settlement instruction for which the market claim has been created.

AccountDetails.name: Account Details
AccountDetails.definition: General information about the safekeeping account, owner and account balance.

CorporateActionDetails.name: Corporate Action Details
CorporateActionDetails.definition: Information about the corporate action event.

MarketClaimType.name: Market Claim Type
MarketClaimType.definition: Type of market claim creation requested.

MarketClaimSettlementIndicator.name: Market Claim Settlement Indicator
MarketClaimSettlementIndicator.definition: Indicates if a market claim will not settle and is created for detection purposes only.

MarketClaimDetails.name: Market Claim Details
MarketClaimDetails.definition: Detailed information about the related corporate action option and related movements to which the market claim is linked.

DeliveringSettlementParties.name: Delivering Settlement Parties
DeliveringSettlementParties.definition: Identifies the chain of delivering settlement parties.

ReceivingSettlementParties.name: Receiving Settlement Parties
ReceivingSettlementParties.definition: Identifies the chain of receiving settlement parties.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
